evidence.heading: B. Information Collected Automatically

G1.rationale: The company collects broad categories of data including device identifiers, usage details, IP address, and location information.

evidence.quote: However, as explained in detail in the “Information Collected Automatically” section above, we may disclose your information to third-party advertising partners to market our own Services and grow our Services’ user base, such as to provide targeted marketing about our own Services via third-party services.
evidence.heading: 3. Disclosing your information

evidence.quote: If you would like to opt out of our online disclosure such as through cookie and pixel technology of your personal information for purposes that could be considered “sales” for those third parties' own commercial purposes, or “sharing” for purposes of targeted advertising, please click on the "Do Not Sell or Share My Info" link on the bottom of our website footer at www.notion.com.
evidence.heading: 6. Your privacy rights

G2.rationale: The policy states that user data may be shared with third-party advertising partners for targeted marketing, but provides a first-party opt-out mechanism via a 'Do Not Sell or Share My Info' link.

evidence.quote: In accordance with applicable legal requirements, we may use your information to tailor and provide you with content and advertisements.
evidence.heading: Complying with our legal obligations

evidence.quote: If you have any questions about our marketing practices or if you would like to opt out of the use of your information for marketing purposes, you may contact us as set forth below.
evidence.heading: Complying with our legal obligations

evidence.quote: Inferences drawn from other personal information to create a profile about a consumer.
evidence.heading: Advertising partners

G3.rationale: The policy notes that inferences are drawn to create profiles and tailor content and ads, while offering an opt-out mechanism.

evidence.quote: We store the information we receive as described in this Privacy Policy for as long as you use our Services or as necessary to fulfill the purpose(s) for which it was collected, provide our Services, resolve disputes, establish legal defenses, conduct audits, pursue legitimate business purposes, enforce our agreements, and comply with applicable laws.
evidence.heading: 7. Data retention

G4.rationale: Data retention is described using generic, purpose-based limits rather than concrete time periods for user content or account data.

evidence.quote: Depending upon your location and in accordance with applicable laws, you may have the right to:

evidence.quote: Access information about you consistent with legal requirements.
evidence.heading: 6. Your privacy rights

evidence.quote: Request Correction of your information where it is inaccurate or incomplete.
evidence.heading: 6. Your privacy rights

evidence.quote: Request Deletion of your information, subject to certain exceptions prescribed by law.
evidence.heading: 6. Your privacy rights

G5.rationale: Access, correction, and deletion rights are explicitly conditioned on user location and local laws rather than being offered unconditionally to all users.

evidence.quote: All information processed by us may be transferred, processed, and stored anywhere in the world, including but not limited to, the United States or other countries, which may have data protection laws that are different from the laws where you live.
evidence.heading: 4. International data transfers

evidence.quote: When we engage in such transfers, we endeavor to safeguard your information consistent with the requirements of applicable laws.
evidence.heading: 4. International data transfers

G6.rationale: Personal data is transferred and stored worldwide, but only generic safeguards consistent with applicable law are mentioned without specifying a legal transfer mechanism.

evidence.quote: Our Services are intended for general audiences and are not directed at children.
evidence.heading: 10. Children's information

evidence.quote: If we become aware that we have collected data without legally valid parental consent from children under an age where such consent is required, we will take reasonable steps to delete it as soon as possible.
evidence.heading: 10. Children's information

G7.rationale: The policy addresses deleting data of children under statutory consent ages, but does not specify protections covering older minors up to age 18.

evidence.quote: We do not process Workspace API user data to develop, improve, or train generalized AI and/or ML models.
